Population increased in Hertfordshire

The estimated population of Hertfordshire in 2024 was 1,236,191 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Hertfordshire increased by 2.9%.

Age profile of Hertfordshire

The average (median) age stayed at 40.6 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Hertfordshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Hertfordshire's population of 1,236,191 usual residents was made up of:

  • 245,290 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.8%)
  • 774,591 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.7%)
  • 216,310 people aged 65 years and over, (17.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Hertfordshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (19.8% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Hertfordshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Hertfordshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Hertfordshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 2,515 people (0.2%). In total, there were 12,404 births and 9,889 deaths in Hertfordshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 822 (0.1%). There were 65,149 people entering the area and 64,327 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Hertfordshire's population of 11,986 (1%) as a result of 19,026 people entering the area and 7,040 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Hertfordshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Hertfordshire in mid-2023 is 1,220,951.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 4,410 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 1,154 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 5,564 people.
